attacks.name: Tempest Mephis - Echo Skill
attacks.sourceText:
Transform into Tempest Mephis to perform tail swing attacks followed by a claw attack. The lightning strike summoned by the tail swing deals 64.05% Electro DMG each time, while the claw attack deals 109.80% Electro DMG.
After the claw hit, increase the current character's Electro DMG by 12.00% and Heavy Attack DMG by 12.00% for 15s.
